## Customize the Primary Menu of the Site

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/customize-the-primary-menu-of-the-site/>

Location: Appearance → Customize → Header → Primary Menu

Spacious allows you to customize the site’s primary menu per your needs. It includes the following options under the Menu.

## Search Icon

The option allows you to display or remove the Search Icon appearing on the primary menu of the Spacious theme.

## Menu Display

It helps you display the menu in a single line.

## Responsive Menu Style

It allows you to enable a new menu style on mobile devices with a sub-menu toggle icon.

## Colors

The option allows you to set the color of the primary menu and sub-menu items. It includes the following options:

- Menu – It allows changing the color of the primary menu items.

- Sub-Menu – It allows changing the color of the sub-menu items.

## Typography

This option allows you to control the typography (Font Family and Size) of your site’s primary menu and sub-menu items. It comes with the following options:

- Menu – It sets the typography of the primary menu items.

- Sub-Menu – It sets the typography of the sub-menu items.

---

## Customize Site Logo, Site Icon, Site Title, and Tagline

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/customize-site-logo-site-icon-site-title-and-tagline/>

Location: Appearance → Customize → Header → Site Identity

Site Identity in the WordPress theme refers to the settings that define the basic branding of the site, like the Site Logo, Icon, Title, and Tagline. Following is the brief overview of the Site Identity options available within the Spacious theme:

## Visibility

The Visibility option in the Spacious theme controls the Site Logo and Text display on your site. You can either enable/disable both of them or display only one.

## Site Logo

The Site Logo is the graphical representation that helps the website visitors to identify and recognize the brands or organization of the website. It comes with the following options for adding the logo to the site.

**Logo**

Upload the **Site Logo** for your site. The suggested Logo dimension is 100*100px.

**Retina Logo**

The **Retina Logo** allows users to upload the Retina (High Definition) version of the logo. This option will ensure that the logo you upload won’t look blurred on high-definition screens.

## Site Icon

The **Site Icon** is the small image or logo that appears on the browser tab while browsing your site. You can upload the Site Icon for your site.

## Site Title

The **Site Title** is the text that appears on the browser’s tab that helps users to understand what a website is about. You can add the appropriate Site Title on the option provided by the Spacious theme.

## Site Tagline

The **Site Tagline** is a short phrase or sentence that summarizes the website’s purpose. Add the appropriate Site Tagline according to the site requirement.

## Colors

The option lets you change the Header Color Text (Title and Tagline) on your site.

## Typography

The option lets you change the Typography for the Header Text (Title and Tagline). It allows you to change the Font Family and Font size of the Header Text.

---

## Header Media Overview

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/header-media-overview/>

Location: Appearance → Customize → Header→ Header Media

The Spacious theme supports the Header Media ( Video/ Image ) provided by WordPress. It is the first thing users see when they visit the website. It can be best for showcasing the brand information, product, or other important information.

### Header Video

Upload your video or add YouTube, Vimeo, or video URL, which appears on the header.

### Header Image

Upload an image for the header area of your site. The recommended image size for the header image is 1400 x 400 px.

## How to Change Header Sidebar Drawer Layout?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/how-to-change-header-drawer-layout/>

Available in **Spacious Pro**

- Go to** Appearance -> Customizer -> Header -> Toggable Header Sidebar**
- Select the option.
- Click on **Publish**.

---

## Add Second Header Button

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/add-second-header-button/>

Spacious Theme allows the addition of the **Two Header Button** in the navigation menu of the header. Once you are under the Header Button area, it comes with various options for customizing the header button listed below: (Available in Spacious pro)

Button Text: You can add the Button Text you want to showcase on the header button.

Button Link: Add the appropriate navigation link to redirect to the respective area while clicking the header button.

Text Color: It allows you to change the Button Text color on both Normal and Hover modes.

Background Color: You can set the background color for the header button on both Normal and Hover modes.

Border Color: It allows you to change the border color of the header button.

Border Width: You can set the appropriate border width of the header button border.

Border Radius: It allows you to set the border radius of the header button border.

---

## Enable/Disable Sticky Menu

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/enable-disable-sticky-menu/>

A sticky menu is a type of navigation menu that remains visible on the top of the page even when the user scrolls down the page. It helps users access the menu from any location on the page without having to scroll to the top of the page. Spacious theme allows you to enable the sticky menu on your end. ** (Available with Spacious Pro) **

In order to enable the sticky menu, Put a checkmark on Check to enable the sticky behavior of the primary menu. This will enable the sticky menu on your end.

---

## How to add Widgets to Header Sidebar Drawer?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/how-to-add-widgets-to-header-sidebar-drawer/>

Available in **Spacious Pro**

- Go to **Appearance **-> **Widgets **page in your WordPress Admin Area
- You will see the Widgets that you can add under the list of **available widgets** then, simply drag and drop to **Header Toggable sidebar one** or **Header Toggable sidebar two** or **Header Toggable sidebar three** or **Header Toggable sidebar four** or **Header Toggable sidebar full** as you desire.

---

## How to Enable/ Disable Header Sidebar Drawer?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/how-to-enable-disable-header-sidebar-drawer/>

Available in **Spacious Pro**

- Go to **Appearance **-> **Customize **-> **Header **-> **Toggable Header Sidebar**.
- Put a checkmark on **Enable Toggle header sidebar**.
- Click on **Publish**.

## Primary Header Overview

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/primary-header-overview/>

**Location: **Appearance → Customize → Header → Primary Header

Generally, the theme’s primary header contains the elements like the Site Identity, Menus, Search Icon, etc. The spacious theme also allows you to add those elements and customize the primary title on your end. Following are the options available:

## Header Display Type

Currenlty four styles are available to show the header on the Spacious theme. You can choose the one that best suits your site.

## Header Border

The Spacious themes allow you to add the header border on the site. Moreover, it provides the option to choose the header border **Color **and **Width**.

## Colors

It allows you to set the **Background Color** of the primary header area.

---

## Customize the Header Top Bar

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/customize-header-top-bar/>

**Location: **Appearance → Customize → Header → Top Bar

The Header Top Bar is a horizontal bar displayed at the Top of the website. Generally, the top bar contains information such as Contact, Social links, CTA Buttons, etc. Spacious themes allow displaying the top header on your site. You can follow the steps below:

## Activate Header Top Bar

In order to enable the Top Bar, put a checkmark on Check to show the top header bar. This will display the header top bar on your end.

## Header Info Text

Upon activating the header top bar, you’ll find the space to add the Header Info text. Generally, in this area, you can add information like Phone Numbers, Email Addresses, etc.

## Header Top Bar Display Type

The spacious theme allows you to choose the options to display the top header type. It comes with the following two options:

Type 1 – It allows you to display the Social icon and text area to display on the left with the menu on the right.

Type 2 – It allows you to display the Social icon and text area to display on the right with the menu on the left.

## Colors

The options allow you to change the colors of the content available on the top header. It allows customizing the color for the three sections of the top header listed below:

Top Header Background – It changes the color of the background of the top header.

Top Header Info – It changes the color of the header info text.

Top Header Menu – It changes the color of the menu present at the top header.

## Typography

The options allow you to change the Font Size of the content available on the top header. It allows customizing the color for the three sections of the top header listed below:

Top Header Info – It changes the font size of the header info text.

Top Header Menu – It changes the font size of the menu present at the top header.
